🍻 Can you afford the round?

Your salary is like walking into the pub with £100. If you don't know what the drinks cost or how long you're staying, don't be surprised when you check your wallet and find £4 left.

A budget isn't about stopping yourself having a pint. It's knowing whether you can afford the fucking round.
